component.name: Clock
घड़ी
component.summary: World clock, alarms, stopwatch and timers
विश्व घड़ी, अलार्म, स्टॉपवॉच और टाइमर

description.p: Clock shows the time around the world on a day and night map, with an analogue face, sunrise and sunset for each city.
Alarms and timers ring with a notification and sound even when Clock is closed, and the stopwatch keeps laps.
